caption: The drawing depicts a monochrome pencil sketch of a rooster-shaped figure mounted on a rectangular, textured base. The rooster figure is simplified and stylized, featuring a single curved piece representing the head, body, tail, and beak, while two straight legs connect it to the base. The base has a rough, wood-like texture, with visible grain patterns and uneven edges, and two protruding nail-like objects are present, one near the left and one near the right. The background is plain, consisting solely of a lightly shaded area bounded by a rectangular border. The overall color is gray, produced by varying pencil shading, and the name "GORDON SANBORN" is written in the lower left corner outside the border.
title: Cock Weather Vane
